questions.question: Karim asks Dr. Sofia: 'How to find a buyer for my father's practice?' Sofia replies:
options: Through the professional network and consulting firms
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, the professional network and specialized consulting firms are the best ways. They know the profiles and expectations of buyers.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage the practice's debts?' Sofia replies:
options: Settle them with the estate's assets
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the debts must be settled with the estate's assets. A notary will accompany you in this process.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'How long does the settlement of an estate take?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, a settlement can take several months, even a year. Be patient and well supported.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to evaluate the value of a dental practice?' Sofia replies that it depends on:
options: The goodwill, patient base, and equipment
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, the value of a practice depends on the goodwill (clientele, reputation), the patient base, and the equipment.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'What to do with the dental equipment?' Sofia advises her to:
options: Sell it or transfer it to the buyer
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the equipment can be sold or transferred to the buyer. A precise inventory is necessary.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'Who inherits the practice under Moroccan law?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, according to Moroccan inheritance law, the heirs are the widow and the children. Each has a share defined by law.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to announce the news to patients?' Sofia advises him to:
options: Send a letter or email to patients
Make an announcement in the newspaper
Post a note on the door
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, a letter or email is more personal. Explain the situation and reassure patients about the continuity of care.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage the practice's employees?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the employees have rights. Inform them, support them, and respect the law regarding dismissal.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'Can we sell the practice to a colleague?' Sofia replies:
options: Yes, it's the most common solution
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, selling to a colleague is the most common solution. It ensures continuity of care.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to know if the practice was profitable?' Sofia advises him to:
options: Analyze the accounts of the last few years
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, analyzing the accounts of the last few years is the only reliable way to know the practice's profitability.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'What to do with patient files after death?' Sofia replies:
options: Keep them and transmit them to the buyer
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, patient files are confidential and must be kept. They will be transmitted to the practice's buyer.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'How to evaluate the practice's debts?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, gather all financial documents to evaluate the debts. An accountant can help you.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'What documents are important for the succession?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, the important documents are bank accounts, contracts, invoices, and of course the will if it exists.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage the stress of this situation?' Sofia advises her to:
options: Surround herself with loved ones and professionals
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, grief and practice management are two trials. Surround yourself with your family and professionals. You are not alone.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'Can I take over the practice as a student?' Sofia replies:
options: Yes, if the diploma is obtained and training is assured
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, you can take over the practice if you obtain your diploma and train in management. But you must have the will.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to manage already scheduled appointments?' Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, contact patients to inform them. Offer to reschedule or redirect to another colleague.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'What are the rights of the heirs?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the heirs have rights over the entire estate. The notary will help you assert them.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'How to manage the practice while waiting for the succession?' Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, secure the practice (lock, alarm) and maintain it. A well-maintained practice sells better.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to know if a buyer is serious?' Sofia replies:
options: Verify his references and professional situation
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, verify references, professional situation, and motivations of the buyer. Don't rush.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage the transmission of the practice's values?' Sofia replies:
options: Transmit them by training the successor
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the practice's values are essential. Transmit them to the successor by explaining your husband's philosophy.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'How to evaluate the goodwill?' Sofia replies:
options: By analyzing the patient base and the practice's reputation
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, goodwill is evaluated by analyzing the patient base (number, loyalty) and the practice's reputation.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to manage tax aspects?' Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, an accountant is essential for managing the tax aspects of the succession.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage grief while managing the practice?' Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, don't handle everything alone. Be supported and take time for yourself. Grief is a necessary stage.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'How to prepare the sale of the practice?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, prepare all documents (accounts, contracts, inventory). A well-prepared practice sells better and for more.'

questions.question: Karim, after going through this ordeal, says to Sofia: 'Thank you. If my father had prepared all this, we wouldn't be lost.' Sofia concludes: 'The preparation of succession is...'
options: A gift for your loved ones
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, the preparation of succession is a gift for your loved ones. It saves them trouble in a time of grief.' Karim: 'I will remember this lesson.'
